title: JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion
abstract: arXiv:2610.00353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. translated_title: JusticeAxis：在僵化规则适用与无依据裁量之间对法律裁判进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 一项合理的裁判是将法律适用于已确立的事实，并权衡事实发生的具体情境。然而，现有方法在僵化的法条匹配与无依据的自由裁量之间摇摆，基准测试仅对标签或评分标准打分，而本可提供这种平衡的经验却始终未经检验。我们将法律裁判形式化为一个以参考为锚定的任务，其目标是一个单一的决策，该决策同时与法条和具体情境保持关联。我们提出了JusticeAxis基准，包含来自18个国家的256个真实刑事案件，附带音频、图像和文本证据，每个案例均有三份由律师撰写的判决：记录在案的判决以及针对每种失败情形的判决。我们进一步提出JusticeAgent框架，其中要素代理负责确立事实，而法官代理则在承载情境经验的技能下适用法律。技能从执行轨迹中蒸馏而来，且仅在贝叶斯可信界限内被采纳。实验…
tldr: 该论文提出了JusticeAxis基准（涵盖18个国家256个真实刑事案件及律师撰写的多重判决）和JusticeAgent多智能体框架，将法律裁判形式化为同时锚定法条与具体情境的任务，并通过从执行轨迹蒸馏、经贝叶斯可信界限验证的技能来平衡僵化规则适用与自由裁量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JusticeAxis, a benchmark of 256 real criminal cases from 18 countries with lawyer-written judgments, and JusticeAgent, a multi-agent framework that formalizes legal judgment as a reference-anchored task balancing rigid rule application and grounded discretion through skills distilled from execution trajectories and admitted under Bayesian credible bounds.
